user.title: ROI Tracker – add an asset
user.description: Pick a template. It determines which fields are offered next.

setup.title: Set up asset
setup.description: Enter the investment and your existing sensors. Amount sensors must be **cumulative meter readings** (kWh), not instantaneous power (kW). Leave fields you don't have empty.

data.name: Asset name
data.start_date: Start date (optional, can be in the past)
data.price_mode: Where does your electricity price (import) come from?
data.reward_mode: Where does your feed-in tariff come from?

data_description.investment: One-time investment in € that should pay off (e.g. 12000).
data_description.start_date: Optionally a date in the past. The calculation then starts retroactively from that day using the stored sensor history. Exact with a fixed price; requires the sensors to have long-term statistics since that date.
data_description.consumption_sensor: PV: self-used energy in kWh – NOT grid import. EV: odometer reading (cumulative km). Heating: energy consumed in kWh.
data_description.export_sensor: Energy exported to the grid in kWh. Feed-in revenue = this × tariff.
data_description.battery_discharge_sensor: Energy taken from the battery in kWh. Counted like self-consumption (× price) as savings.
data_description.price_mode: Determines how the monetary value of your self-consumption is calculated. You enter the matching value/sensor in the next step.

sources.title: Prices & feed-in
sources.description: Enter the values matching your selection. Prices always in **€ per kWh** (e.g. 0.30).

data_description.price_fixed: Your energy price per kWh, e.g. 0.30. Multiplied by self-consumption.
data_description.price_sensor: A sensor providing the current energy price in €/kWh (e.g. Tibber). Each self-used kWh is valued at the price at that moment.
data_description.cost_sensor: Only choose this if you already have a sensor accumulating the saved amount in €. NOT your electricity bill / "accumulated cost" – that would be expenses, not savings.
data_description.reward_fixed: Your feed-in tariff per kWh, e.g. 0.08.
data_description.reward_sensor: A sensor accumulating the feed-in revenue received in €.

legacy.title: Old solution comparison
legacy.description:
Enter the consumption of your **old solution** (combustion car / old heating). ROI Tracker uses this to show how much money you save compared to the old way.

All fields are optional. Leave empty to disable the comparison.

data_description.legacy_consumption: For EV: fuel consumption of old car in L/100 km (e.g. 8.5). For heating: consumption per 100 m² per year or per 100 kWh, depending on the fuel. Multiplied by the fuel price → gives €/100 units.
data_description.legacy_fuel_type: Select the fuel or energy carrier of the old solution. Informational only – does not affect calculation.
data_description.fuel_price_fixed: Price per litre, m³ or kWh of the old fuel, e.g. 1.85 €/L for diesel.
data_description.fuel_price_sensor: Optional: HA sensor providing the current fuel price. Takes priority over the fixed value.

init.title: Edit asset
init.description: Adjust investment, sensors and price sources. Amount sensors are cumulative kWh meter readings. Changes apply immediately.

data.start_date: Start date (optional, can be in the past)

data_description.export_sensor: Energy exported to the grid in kWh.
data_description.battery_discharge_sensor: Energy taken from the battery in kWh.

legacy.description: Adjust the old solution data. Leaving fields empty disables the comparison.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Resets a ROI calculator to zero. All accumulated values and the stored state are cleared.

recalculate.name: Recalculate retroactively
recalculate.description: Resets a ROI calculator and recalculates it retroactively from the stored sensor history.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Date to calculate from retroactively (optional; otherwise the start date configured on the asset).
